from pathlib import Path
import json

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
names = {}


def capture_names(page):
    from PySide6.QtGui import QAccessible
    targets = {'work_list': page.work.tasks, 'cancel_job': page.work.cancel_button,
               'newcomers': page.newcomers, 'zone': page.zone_combo,
               'furniture_storage': page.layout_panel.storage,
               'theme': page.layout_panel.theme, 'arrange': page.layout_panel.arrange}
    for key, widget in targets.items():
        interface = QAccessible.queryAccessibleInterface(widget)
        assert interface is not None, key
        names[key] = {'name': interface.text(QAccessible.Text.Name),
                      'description': interface.text(QAccessible.Text.Description),
                      'role': str(interface.role()), 'visible': widget.isVisible()}


source = (ROOT / '.audit/check_home_keyboard_flow.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
source = source.replace('            tab_to(app, window, page.work.tasks)\n',
                        '            capture_names(page)\n            tab_to(app, window, page.work.tasks)\n')
source = source.replace("'.audit/home-keyboard-flow-result.json'", "'.audit/home-accessibility-keyboard-result.json'")
exec(compile(source, str(ROOT / '.audit/check_home_keyboard_flow.py'), 'exec'))
(ROOT / '.audit/home-accessible-names.json').write_text(json.dumps(names, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(names), flush=True)

"""Widget-local keyboard events in an offscreen full MainUI."""
import json
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
from time import monotonic

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
os.environ['QT_QPA_PLATFORM'] = 'offscreen'
trace = []


def tab_to(app, window, target):
    for count in range(400):
        current = app.focusWidget()
        if current is target:
            trace.append({'target': target.objectName() or type(target).__name__, 'tabs': count})
            return
        QTest.keyClick(current or window, Qt.Key.Key_Tab)
        app.processEvents()
    raise AssertionError(('Unreachable by Tab', type(target).__name__, target.objectName()))


previous = Path.cwd()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='front-keyboard-flow-') as name:
    os.chdir(name)
    try:
        Path('user_setting.json').write_text(json.dumps({'language': 'English', 'smart_pause': False,
            'pet_home_on_desktop': False, 'pet_home_running': False}))
        from PySide6.QtCore import QCoreApplication, QEvent, Qt
        from PySide6.QtTest import QTest
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
        from frontengine.ui import main_ui
        from frontengine.ui.page.pet_game import home_page
        from frontengine.utils.pet_game import simulation
        from frontengine.utils.session_lock import session_lock
        main_ui.CriticalExit.init_critical_exit = lambda self: None
        main_ui.HotkeyService.start = lambda self: False
        main_ui.AppProfileService.start = lambda self: None
        main_ui.ShareWatchService.start = lambda self: None
        home_page.workshop_pack_roots = lambda: []
        session_lock.is_session_locked = lambda: False
        app = QApplication([])
        app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(False)
        window = main_ui.FrontEngineMainUI(show_system_tray_ray=False, redirect_output=False)
        try:
            window.resize(1280, 900)
            window.show()
            app.processEvents()
            page = window.pet_home_ui
            assert page.isVisible()
            tab_to(app, window, page.create_button)
            QTest.keyClick(app.focusWidget(), Qt.Key.Key_Space)
            app.processEvents()
            assert page.service.world is not None and len(page.service.world.residents) == 1
            page.service.pause('keyboard-probe')
            simulation.advance(page.service.world, 180000)
            page.refresh()
            assert page.service.world.tasks
            bar = page.tabs.tabBar()
            tab_to(app, window, bar)
            while page.tabs.currentIndex() != 1:
                QTest.keyClick(bar, Qt.Key.Key_Right)
                app.processEvents()
            tab_to(app, window, page.work.tasks)
            QTest.keyClick(app.focusWidget(), Qt.Key.Key_Home)
            app.processEvents()
            selection = {'after_home': {'row': page.work.tasks.currentRow(),
                         'selected': len(page.work.tasks.selectedItems()),
                         'count': page.work.tasks.count(),
                         'focus': type(app.focusWidget()).__name__}}
            QTest.keyClick(app.focusWidget(), Qt.Key.Key_Down)
            app.processEvents()
            selection['after_down'] = {'row': page.work.tasks.currentRow(),
                                       'selected': len(page.work.tasks.selectedItems())}
            QTest.keyClick(app.focusWidget(), Qt.Key.Key_Space)
            app.processEvents()
            selection['after_space'] = {'row': page.work.tasks.currentRow(),
                                        'selected': len(page.work.tasks.selectedItems())}
            (ROOT / '.audit/home-keyboard-selection.json').write_text(json.dumps(selection, indent=2))
            assert page.work.tasks.selectedItems()
            before = len(page.service.world.tasks)
            tab_to(app, window, page.work.cancel_button)
            QTest.keyClick(app.focusWidget(), Qt.Key.Key_Space)
            app.processEvents()
            assert len(page.service.world.tasks) == before - 1
            tab_to(app, window, bar)
            QTest.keyClick(bar, Qt.Key.Key_Right)
            app.processEvents()
            assert page.tabs.currentIndex() == 2
            tab_to(app, window, page.layout_panel.arrange)
            QTest.keyClick(app.focusWidget(), Qt.Key.Key_Space)
            app.processEvents()
            assert page.layout_panel.arranging
            QTest.keyClick(app.focusWidget(), Qt.Key.Key_Escape)
            app.processEvents()
            assert not page.layout_panel.arranging
            assert app.focusWidget() is not None and app.focusWidget().isVisible()
            result = {'created_home': True, 'cancelled_automatic_work': True,
                      'entered_and_escaped_arranging': True, 'tab_routes': trace,
                      'selection': selection,
                      'final_focus': type(app.focusWidget()).__name__}
        finally:
            window.request_shutdown()
            deadline = monotonic() + 90
            while not window.lifetime.closed and monotonic() < deadline:
                QCoreApplication.sendPostedEvents(None, QEvent.Type.DeferredDelete)
                app.processEvents()
            assert window.lifetime.closed
            window.deleteLater()
            QCoreApplication.sendPostedEvents(None, QEvent.Type.DeferredDelete)
        logging.shutdown()
    finally:
        os.chdir(previous)
(ROOT / '.audit/home-keyboard-flow-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
